title: Students with only one course get groups that are too big
text:
## Problem

Students who are enrolled in only one course often end up in groups of 7 or 8 people, even though the maximum group size is 5.

## Cause

The matching service v0.3 relaxes the size limit when it can't find enough overlapping free time for a student. Students with a single course have fewer possible matches, so they hit this fallback much more often.

## Proposed fix

- Never go above 5 members
- If no group fits, put the student on a short waiting list and retry matching every 6 hours

Found by Daniel Ortiz while testing with the Westbrook sample data. Fix in progress.
